com.vector.cfg.automation.scripting.api.project

Interface IProjectRef.IProjectRefAdvancedUsage

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IHasURI, IProjectRef
    Enclosing interface:
    IProjectRef

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public static interface IProjectRef.IProjectRefAdvancedUsage
extends IProjectRef
    IProjectRef.IProjectRefAdvancedUsage provides methods for advanced usages of IProject instances.
    Advanced Open Project Use Cases
    The method IProjectRef.advanced() provides methods for advanced usages of IProject instances. For example you can open a project which will not be closed when the open stack frame is left. This can be helpful for unit tests.
    • IProjectRefAdvancedUsage.openProject(): Open the project and return the IProject as reference, but you have to manually close the project.
    The IProjectRef.IProjectRefAdvancedUsage API this only for special use cases, with have very narrow scope. If you are not sure that you need it don't use it.

        @PublishedMethod
IProject openProject()
        Opens this IProjectRef's IProject and returns the IProject.

        Caution: You have to close the IProject, with the IProject.close() method, when you are finished with processing. If the IProject is not could until the IScriptTask execution is finished, to execution will fail!

        Returns:
        the opened project
